original.statement: The Marathon provider has been removed in Traefik v3.0.0 and Marathon-related configuration is no longer supported.

of.needed: whether a static configuration file (YAML providers.marathon / TOML [providers.marathon]) used by Traefik, or any --providers.marathon.* sub-option flag, contains Marathon provider configuration

corrected.statement: Exposed: any environment whose Traefik static configuration still has Marathon provider config, whether in Helm values (providers.marathon), as the --providers.marathon CLI flag, or in a YAML/TOML static config file or Marathon sub-option flags that the static inputs cannot always show. In v3 such config is unsupported and stops Traefik from starting.

decision.reason: [ev-c71146d39072] shows Marathon provider config in three static-config forms: File (YAML) `providers: marathon: {}`, File (TOML) `[providers.marathon]`, and CLI `--providers.marathon=true`. It says any of these stops Traefik from starting and that all Marathon-related config must be removed. The proposed condition checks only Helm values and the exact `--providers.marathon` flag. It misses a static config file (YAML/TOML) that is not built from Helm values, and Marathon sub-options set as flags. Those exposed environments need an operand that says they cannot be decided statically, so that the condition is not narrower than the exposure.
